description: Ty Masterson wants Kansans to trust him with the state’s finances, but new reporting out today from American Journal News shows how the last operation under his leadership turned out. MasterBuilt Homes, the Andover homebuilder Masterson co-founded and led as CEO, collapsed into Chapter 7 bankruptcy carrying $1.13 million in debts it could not pay.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: New Report: Ty Masterson Ran His Business Into Bankruptcy and Left Kansans Unpaid | Cindy Holscher for Governor
